_doc: Camera settings (Patch10), written for the Player seat. top = the top view (orthographic, looking straight down): height above the table, rotationDeg turns the picture on screen, minHalfHeight / halfHeightAspect = how much of the table fits (half height in metres, at least halfHeightAspect / aspect), zoom limits and wheel speed, panLimit = how far the drag may pan (metres). classic = the side camera used when the 3D view is not available: position, target (it looks at it), fov, near, far, maxPolarDeg (the orbit cannot go lower). seat = the camera for the Opponent seat is this one turned by opponentYawDeg round the table centre; turnSpeed = how fast it turns (0..1 per frame). The 3D side view has its own file: config/camera3d.json (position + target, or rotationDeg [x, y, z]). See Docs/CAMERA.md
